name: VI, VII
identityFinding: VI, VII is a gallery operator and public identity that has used multiple Oslo exhibition locations and international fair sites; it is not the building or a permanent site at Nedre Slottsgate 8.
currentLocationFinding: The official contact page says the private showroom program at Nedre Slottsgate 8 ran through December 2025. No inspected 2026 source establishes that address or another address as a current permanent public gallery location.
contractFinding: data/brands/brand_rules_v1_1.json classifies ordinary galleries as brand-first unless the physical site has independent historical, architectural, institutional or urban primacy. No inspected source establishes that primacy for the VI, VII marker.
microFinding: Micro is not applicable because VI, VII is an operator identity rather than a small permanent physical service, plaque, cabinet, stone or comparable point.

sources.sourceLocation: Contact lines and About us: Nedre Slottsgate 8 showroom through December 2025; gallery founded below a church hall in 2012; Bjørvika location from 2021.
Exhibition register: first 2012 shows; 2025 Eliza Douglas and Bjarne Melgaard entries; no 2026 exhibition listed at review time.
2017 interview with Esperanza Rosales on founding, international network and artist-/project-space model.
Venue chronology from 2012 through the 2025 Nedre Slottsgate 8 exhibition.

rejectedAlternatives.reason: The operator cannot naturally carry four site-owned PlaceCard collections, and the physical address lacks independent place primacy.
Micro is a compact tier for small permanent physical points, not for mobile venue or business identities.
The 2025 showroom was time-bounded; no source supports making VI, VII a current Brand member of the Steen & Strøm PlaceCard.
